name: attributes
description: Populates all Selling_Attributes rows for a product in one pass. Each attribute row is matched to its closest valid value with optional UOM conversion.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number

attributes.attribute_name: string — attribute name echoed from input
attributes.selected_value: string | null — matched value from validValues after any UOM conversion
attributes.original_value_found: string | null — raw value found in search results before conversion
attributes.conversion_notes: string | null — description of any unit conversion performed
